item.title: Cleveland State men drop second in a row, 85-68, to Robert Morris
item.description: Cleveland State went in the final 5 minutes of the first half, and Robert Morris surged ahead on its way to an 85-68 victory on Feb. 12 at the Wolstein Center. The Vikings led, 30-24, with 5:37 remaining in the first half. But they only scored three points over the next 8-plus minutes of game time, stretching into the second half.
